name: report-diet
description: When a subagent's report reaching the agent that started it is long, the whole text is saved to a file in the system temp folder and the parent reads its start, its end and the file's path, so its context stays small

enabled.title: Report diet
enabled.description: Off: subagent reports reach the parent whole, as they always do.

maxChars.title: Longest report kept whole (characters)
maxChars.description: A subagent report longer than this is cut. 1000 to 100000.

headChars.title: Start kept (characters)
headChars.description: How much of a cut report's start the parent reads. 200 to 100000; with the end kept, at most 90% of the longest report kept whole.

tailChars.title: End kept (characters)
tailChars.description: How much of a cut report's end the parent reads. 0 to 100000.

exclude.title: Subagent types never cut
exclude.description: Subagent types whose reports always reach the parent whole, separated by commas. Explore and Plan answers are search results and plans meant to be read in full. Empty: none.
